decisions.reason: Locates 42 .events reads in plugin-source-excerpt.js, crash stack TypeError events is not iterable at prepareReplayEvents during apply(), changelog removal at 0.1.2-alpha.4 with seq/eventAt()/snapshotEvents() replacements; explains undefined read then iteration throw.

alpha.5 inside >=0.1.2-alpha.2 <0.2.0-0 so silent install; npm compares version strings only, never loads plugin or inspects API surface; peer declaration is author claim, not evidence of testing; engines is environment not API.

Six distinct classes: removed/renamed member (this incident), changed signature/shape of surviving member (commands.execute images arg, seedLength), behavioral/default change, event/wire contract drift, composition/activation-plane failure, type-vs-runtime divergence.

Testing required (top of declared range or cold-boot smoke, typecheck against real cohort) plus policy: upper-bound peer range below removal (<0.1.2-alpha.4) or runtime feature-detection adapter with old/new paths and readable error; version metadata vs runtime guard roles explained.

Concrete pre-install check: expand peer range to corridor, read release notes for removals, npm pack and grep plugin source for session.events/.events.at( hits, cross-check removal ledgers and typings; explicitly tied to this Session.events boundary; notes rerunning npm checks is insufficient.

caps.reason: Conclusions consistently state peer satisfaction is a static version check that cannot prove runtime API compatibility; removal confirmed.
